scientific_status: exploratory; provisional geometry; no learned task success established
comparison_rules: Compare normalized L1 only within identical action coordinates, action normalization and validation protocol.
ACT metrics cover all overlapping chunk offsets; small-head metrics cover unique executed prefixes, so do not rank ACT against the heads by these numbers.
Joint, absolute-pose, base-frame delta and tool-frame delta scores cannot rank action representations.
Single seed and 64k-example budgets (6.65 dataset passes), not the planned 320k-example full schedule; best checkpoints selected on the same six validation episodes.
No confidence intervals or reserved-set results.

best_single_camera_sim_candidate.reason: Only iPhone camera requested; wrist/top recording key has no measured simulator mount. Still provisional calibration, not approved physical execution.

findings.flow_conclusion: Regression outperforms matched flow heads at 64k examples with either DINO or CLIP; all four models underperform the same executed-prefix persistence baseline in normalized L1.
findings.action_conclusion: No comparable physical-space or closed-loop ranking yet; normalized target scores are not commensurate.

mps_profile.synchronization: torch.mps.synchronize immediately before and after each timed call
mps_profile.includes: cached image access, normalization, collation, input transfer, all vision/head computation, action denormalization, output transfer
mps_profile.excludes: model loading, sensor acquisition and simulator rendering
